s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive skin lesions with inflammatory infiltrate and history of local excisions and immunotherapy
salient_findings: New and progressive satellite lesions despite pembrolizumab therapy
History of wide local excisions and graft repair for scalp lesion
Incidentally resected lymph node with focal involvement
key_facts: Male patient in his 50s
Initial wide local excision with graft repair for left posterior auricular scalp lesion
Incidentally resected lymph node showed focal involvement
No evidence of distant metastatic disease at initial resection
Received 4 cycles of ipilimumab
Underwent second wide local excision due to new lesions
Began pembrolizumab therapy due to additional satellite lesions
Local progression occurred in satellite lesions after 5 cycles of pembrolizumab
Histopathology showed intense mixed superficial and deep dermal inflammatory infiltrate
Immunostaining results highlighted normal melanocytes, histiocytes, and neutrophils

shortlist.label: Melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of melanoma treatment and recurrence

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive skin lesions with inflammatory infiltrate

shortlist.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Mixed inflammatory infiltrate and history of local excisions

shortlist.label: Merkel cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive skin lesion with history of immunotherapy

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of skin lesions and local excisions

raw.rationale: The patient's history of a scalp lesion with focal lymph node involvement, subsequent development of satellite lesions, and histopathology showing intense mixed inflammatory infiltrate with normal melanocytes highlighted by SOX-10 and MART-1 immunostaining are consistent with melanoma.

rejected.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
rejected.why: No characteristic storiform or cartwheel pattern of dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans mentioned in histopathology

rejected.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
rejected.why: Lack of specific Langerhans cell histiocytosis markers and characteristic histiocytic infiltrate

rejected.label: Merkel cell carcinoma
rejected.why: No mention of Merkel cell carcinoma-specific histopathological features or immunostaining results

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: No evidence of squamous cell carcinoma-specific histopathological features such as keratin pearls or individual cell keratinization
